comparison.objective: Install a toilet roll on a spring spindle by seating one end and steering the free end into the opposite socket; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring compression, one-end support, lateral steering and socket seating versus small-tool insertion, rotary adjustment and lock verification.
comparison.success_condition: Both spindle ends seated with roll retained and released versus two stable non-bottoming carriage stops. Candidate lacks numeric rebound/overload/drift limits.
comparison.reason: Spring-loaded two-socket installation tests constrained insertion, not adjustable damping.
